'''Sap''' was a fluid found in [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. In the anatomy of the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Species/Legends|species]], sap served as an analog to [[Blood/Legends|blood]], as found in [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other species.<ref name="RH">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']].</ref> The [[dagger thorn]] was a weapon that secreted a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] sap that could kill a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a mere scratch.<ref name="M20">[[Star Wars (1977) 20|''Star Wars'' (1977) 20]].</ref>
